representation_constraints: Each object must be representable as one rooted URDF joint tree.
No prompt requires a closed kinematic loop, flexible transmission, or deformable part.
Parts not named as moving may remain fixed.

prompts.prompt: Create a compact tracked excavator. The upper body should rotate on the track base, and the digging arm should have a moving boom, stick, and bucket. Add a cab and a front dozer blade that can raise and lower.

Create a powered hospital bed on caster wheels. The bed platform should raise and lower on a vertical lift column, while the backrest and leg sections adjust independently. Add side rails that can fold down.
Create a folding bicycle with a central frame hinge. Include rotating wheels, working steering, a crank with pedals, an adjustable seat post, and a handlebar stem that can fold for storage.

Create a sliding compound miter saw on a stable base. The saw should have a rotating table, a rail that lets the saw head slide, a bevel adjustment, a plunging saw arm, and a rotating blade with a movable guard.

Create a built-in dishwasher with a front door that opens downward. Include two racks that slide out, a utensil basket, and upper and lower spray arms that rotate. Add a small detergent door on the inside of the main door.

Create a communications satellite with a central equipment body. Add two solar arrays that unfold from the sides and a dish antenna that can turn and tilt. Include a small instrument cover that opens.
Create an enclosed benchtop CNC milling machine. The worktable should move left and right and forward and backward, while the spindle head moves vertically. Add a front safety door that slides open.

Create a wall bed inside a shallow cabinet. The bed frame should fold down from the wall, and two support legs should unfold from the frame. Add a headboard panel and cabinet doors that open without blocking the bed.

Create a self-propelled crop sprayer with four rotating wheels, steering front wheels, a raised cab, and a rear tank. Mount the spray boom on a vertical slide so it can raise and lower. Each side of the boom should fold through two joints for transport.

Create a professional video tripod with three telescoping legs. Each leg should spread from the center and extend in two stages. Add an adjustable center column and a camera head that can pan and tilt.
